server.name: mangwale-commerce
server.description: Mangwale — India's hyperlocal food delivery, e-commerce & parcel platform. Order food from restaurants, shop products, and send parcels in Nashik and expanding cities.

streamable_http.description: Modern stateful transport (recommended). Send initialize request, receive mcp-session-id header for subsequent requests.

sse.description: Legacy SSE transport for backwards compatibility.

authentication.description: Phone-based OTP authentication for transactional tools. Use send_otp → verify_otp to obtain an auth_token.
flow: 3. Call verify_otp with phone + OTP to get auth_token

discovery.description: Browse restaurants, search items, check coverage — no authentication required.

tools.name: search_restaurants
tools.description: Search for restaurants by query, location, cuisine, or dietary preference.

tools.name: get_restaurant_menu
tools.description: Get the full menu of a restaurant grouped by category with prices and availability.

tools.name: search_items
tools.description: Search for food items or products across all stores. Supports food and e-commerce modules.

tools.name: check_serviceability
tools.description: Check if Mangwale delivers to a specific location by lat/lng.

tools.name: get_coupons
tools.description: Get available discount coupons. Pass auth_token for personalized offers.

tools.name: get_payment_methods
tools.description: Get available payment methods (COD, digital, wallet) by service module.

tools.name: get_categories
tools.description: Get food or product categories. Optionally filter by a specific store.

tools.name: conversational_search
tools.description: Context-aware multi-turn search. Handles follow-ups like 'cheaper ones', 'show more', 'veg only'.

tools.name: order_by_recipe
tools.description: Order ingredients or dishes for a recipe/meal. Decomposes recipe name into searchable ingredients and finds matching items.

tools.name: send_otp
tools.description: Send a one-time password to a phone number for authentication.

tools.name: verify_otp
tools.description: Verify OTP and get an auth_token for transactional tools.

transactional.description: Cart, ordering, address, and wallet management — requires auth_token from verify_otp.

tools.name: add_to_cart
tools.description: Add food items to the shopping cart.

tools.name: place_order
tools.description: Place a food order with delivery address and payment method.

tools.name: get_addresses
tools.description: Get the user's saved delivery addresses.

tools.name: add_address
tools.description: Add a new delivery address with lat/lng coordinates.

tools.name: get_wallet_balance
tools.description: Check the user's Mangwale wallet balance.

tools.name: get_order_status
tools.description: Get current status and details of a specific order.

tools.name: get_order_history
tools.description: Get past orders with pagination and module filter.

tools.name: cancel_order
tools.description: Cancel an eligible order (pending/failed status only).

steps: User: 'Order ingredients for paneer butter masala'
→ Returns ingredient breakdown with matching items from nearby stores
